newsitem.title: USA: Boeing CEO says Pentagon "positive" on merger.
newsitem.headline: Boeing CEO says Pentagon "positive" on merger.

text.p: Boeing Co Chief Executive Officer Phil Condit said initial reaction from Pentagon officials to the company's planned merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp have been "very, very positive."

Condit, speaking at a news conference in Seattle, said he held broad overview discussions with Pentagon officials on Monday, a day after Boeing announced its plan to acquire McDonnell Douglas for about $14 billion in stock.
"This is just the very beginning of the formal process," he said. "Overall the reaction has been very, very positive."
